newsitem.title: USA: Life Medical can't explain stock drop.
newsitem.headline: Life Medical can't explain stock drop.

text.p: Life Medical Sciences Inc said Tuesday that it sees no reason for the recent decline in its stock price.
The company said it recently announced that pivotal clinical trials are scheduled to begin for PILIEL, its hair regrowth product, and CARIEL, its topical wound-healing gel, in Europe in November.
The company said its confidence continues to grow on the market prospects for these two products as well as for its REPEL bioresorbable adhesion barrier film.
The company said its balance sheet remains strong, with cash and cash equivalents of over $15 million.
